label: final copy step of length-3 sequences (plus weak late-copy firing)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, never during the original tokens or on <DEL>. Its core, and all of its strongest activations, is the last step of L=3 sequences (t=5, input orig(1), output orig(2)). There it is active 97% of the time and holds about 51% of the activation mass, independent of which token is involved. The remaining mass is weak (mostly under 0.3 of max) and spread over the last one or two copy steps of longer sequences: recall_idx 2 for L=4, and the final steps for L=6, 7 and 9, but rarely for L=5 or 8. Within that tail it fires on only about 5-8% of eligible steps, with a mild preference for input tokens b/r/e/g that I could not turn into a clean rule. The broad predicate phase==2 & to_go<=1 reaches 96% mass recall but only 6% precision.
